description: Data for Jev-style decision models. Notes say where labels come from: humans, exact rules or an LLM teacher. Last updated 2026-09-24.

note.html: EVAL · human labels. 22 public classification/NLI/rating sets recast as choice/noul/score. Some configs (e.g. chaosnli, 100 annotators per item) carry human label distributions, so you can test calibration, not only accuracy.
note.text: EVAL · human labels. 22 public classification/NLI/rating sets recast as choice/noul/score. Some configs (e.g. chaosnli, 100 annotators per item) carry human label distributions, so you can test calibration, not only accuracy.

note.html: EVAL · synthetic, soft labels. The most-used shared benchmark: one state, several typed questions answered together, gold as a probability distribution. 4 workflows, 1.2k train / 400 test. PT/ES translation: telepatia-ai/typed-decisions-pt-es.
note.text: EVAL · synthetic, soft labels. The most-used shared benchmark: one state, several typed questions answered together, gold as a probability distribution. 4 workflows, 1.2k train / 400 test. PT/ES translation: telepatia-ai/typed-decisions-pt-es.

note.html: EVAL/TRAIN · exact rule labels. Procedurally generated states where every answer is computed from rules stated in the state, so labels have no noise. Good for checking reasoning over state, not guessing.
note.text: EVAL/TRAIN · exact rule labels. Procedurally generated states where every answer is computed from rules stated in the state, so labels have no noise. Good for checking reasoning over state, not guessing.

note.html: EVAL · human gold (Mind2Web). Web-agent decisions: pick the right page element, plus a yes/no per candidate. Test and OOD splits hold out whole websites.

title: Apex family
description: Evidence in, decisions out. GLiClass 4 based Large Decision Models for text and images. Open weights for routing, triage, moderation, and ranking.

note.html:
Apex-flash | 0.4B | Text | CPU or GPU

The compact model for high-volume decisions: route tickets, triage requests, apply moderation policies, and choose the next action. Supply evidence, an instruction, and candidate answers. Change the policy, not the model. GLiClass 4 based; open weights under Apache 2.0.
note.text:
Apex-flash | 0.4B | Text | CPU or GPU

The compact model for high-volume decisions: route tickets, triage requests, apply moderation policies, and choose the next action. Supply evidence, an instruction, and candidate answers. Change the policy, not the model. GLiClass 4 based; open weights under Apache 2.0.

note.html:
Apex-large | 9B | Text and images | GPU recommended

For knowledge-heavy decisions and workflows that combine text with screenshots, receipts, charts, or camera frames. Supports instruction-guided classification and streaming conversations through a per-session KV cache. GLiClass 4 based; open weights under Apache 2.0.
